baseline_rule: At Task Session admission capture sha256 or absent for every closeout target; Invoke Refresh must reject any pre-apply mismatch and must never auto-start the successor.

units.primary_behavior: Accept exactly the SF-01 through SF-21 candidate contract and reject a one-branch mutation.
units.acceptance_boundary: A dependency-free Node test accepts the bound contract and rejects missing, extra, changed, stale-digest, and authority mutants.
units.split_analysis: Schema, accepted instance, validator, and mutant test are jointly necessary for one executable trust check; package identity remains independently testable in SWU-SFC-002.

units.primary_behavior: Create the isolated @domainspec-v2/cli package, bin, and type boundary without changing root dependency authority.
units.acceptance_boundary: Package metadata and boundary tests expose only the supported entry while development commands and factory surfaces remain internal.
units.split_analysis: Metadata, minimal entry, version module, README, and boundary test form one import identity; lock migration remains SWU-SFC-009.
units.validation_command: npm --prefix projects/domainspec-v2/impl exec -- tsc --project cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node --test projects/domainspec-v2/impl/cli/test/contract/package-boundary.test.mjs

units.primary_behavior: Produce one deterministic contained source manifest only from an explicit project root.
units.acceptance_boundary: Byte-identical arbitrary roots produce one digest; fallback, escape, symlink, duplicate, and wrong-root mutants fail with exit 22.
units.split_analysis: Containment, topology enumeration, ordering, digest, fixtures, and tests are inseparable for one trustworthy source-manifest behavior; profile semantics remain SWU-SFC-004.

units.primary_behavior: Verify exact 13-kind and 16-relation P2 membership plus independently owned C2 expected and executed causal bindings.
units.acceptance_boundary: The approved binding passes; missing, extra, stale, self-issued, source-mutated, causal-removal, and owner-digest mutants fail.
units.split_analysis: P2 and C2 keep distinct owners but share one admission because C2 is defined over the exact P2 source set.

units.primary_behavior: Closed-decode and canonicalize StructuralReceipt v1 with exact producer, runtime, profile, source, evidence, and authority-none bindings.
units.acceptance_boundary: A valid receipt round-trips byte-stably while unknown, missing, malformed, future-major, stale, forbidden-authority, and excerpt mutants fail.
units.split_analysis: Schema, codec, canonicalizer, fixtures, and tests form one round-trip contract; diagnostic output remains SWU-SFC-006.

units.primary_behavior: Closed-decode and deterministically paginate DiagnosticReport v1 with stable pointer-only findings and faults.
units.acceptance_boundary: Sort, page digest, report digest, token, replay, schema, channel, and redaction mutants are discriminated.
units.split_analysis: The page token has no valid semantics outside the exact normalized report contract, so schema and pagination remain one output behavior; command execution remains SWU-SFC-007.

units.primary_behavior: Execute lint with an explicit project root and emit deterministic paginated DiagnosticReport JSON with exact exits.
units.acceptance_boundary: Green, structural red, usage, path, profile, resource, token, order, page, fallback, channel, and no-write fixtures pass.
units.split_analysis: Grammar, evaluation, pagination, and channel mapping are one externally visible lint behavior; receipt projection remains SWU-SFC-008.

units.primary_behavior: Execute receipt with an explicit project root and emit one compact closed StructuralReceipt whose exit reflects structural acceptance.
units.acceptance_boundary: Green and structural-red receipts close-decode; unsupported flags, serializer faults, output caps, partial stdout, and filesystem writes fail.
units.split_analysis: Receipt projection and atomic channel behavior form one externally reviewable contract; lint pagination remains independently accepted in SWU-SFC-007.

units.primary_behavior: Resolve one complete npm 11.17.0 lock-v3 dependency graph and build-script policy without renaming the impl workspace.
units.acceptance_boundary: Exact versions, integrity, workspaces, dependencies, and reviewed scripts pass while pnpm authority, ranges, drift, missing integrity, and network policy fail.
units.split_analysis: Root package, root lock, competing manifest removal, CLI dependency declaration, and policy validator form one authority transition; artifact reproduction remains SWU-SFC-010.

units.primary_behavior: Compile and stage the exact CLI artifact with no runtime install, then reproduce artifact and normalized results from two clean roots.
units.acceptance_boundary: The manifest binds all inputs, two roots produce equal hashes, and path, time, cache, source-run, network, and runtime-install mutants fail.
units.split_analysis: Compilation, staging manifest, clean-root harness, and equality comparator form one reproducible artifact behavior; dependency audit remains SWU-SFC-011.

units.primary_behavior: Produce total exact-byte dependency, SBOM, license, integrity, reachability, and install-script evidence for the candidate graph.
units.acceptance_boundary: Every lock package is classified and reachable or build-only; unknown integrity, license, script, duplicate version, or unused shipped dependency fails.
units.split_analysis: Inventory, SBOM, license, integrity, reachability, and script classes jointly answer one shipped-dependency closure question; runtime abuse remains SWU-SFC-012.

units.primary_behavior: Prove pointer-only output and no network, telemetry, or ambient disclosure under supported green, red, and fault paths.
units.acceptance_boundary: Source, path, environment, stack, and secret canaries never leak; denied network, permissions, temp, symlink, race, and partial-output negatives pass.
units.split_analysis: Redaction, environment, network, permissions, and cleanup share one disclosure boundary because a leak through any channel violates SEC1; dependency metadata closed in SWU-SFC-011.

units.primary_behavior: Deterministically census and admit or reject record count, total bytes, per-file bytes, and projected output before full evaluation.
units.acceptance_boundary: Exact boundaries admit; plus-one, overflow, size-race, symlink, changed-after-census, and output-cap mutants fail early with exit 23.
units.split_analysis: The four limits share one source snapshot and preflight decision; separating them permits time-of-check drift. Measured performance remains SWU-SFC-014.

units.primary_behavior: Measure wall time, peak RSS, result bytes, and early-failure behavior for the declared Linux x64 and Node 24.19.0 corpus dimensions.
units.acceptance_boundary: Repeated boundary and over-bound runs yield schema-valid receipts; the boundary stays within two minutes and four GiB while over-bound input fails early.
units.split_analysis: Corpus builder, runner, sampler, and comparator jointly establish one measured envelope; enforcement closed in SWU-SFC-013.

units.primary_behavior: Read current and one explicitly supported predecessor for both public contracts while preserving original identity and rejecting unsupported input.
units.acceptance_boundary: Current and N-1 fixtures decode to versioned models while future, unknown, expired, lossy, ambiguous, and silent-coercion mutants fail.
units.split_analysis: Receipt and diagnostic decoders share one support policy and timeline; retention storage remains independently testable in SWU-SFC-016.

units.primary_behavior: Validate permanent release and receipt lookup, 90-day diagnostic expiry, safe cache cleanup, and secret quarantine without breaking references.
units.acceptance_boundary: Referenced history remains reachable while only eligible unreferenced diagnostics expire; delete-history and dangling-reference mutants fail.
units.split_analysis: Lookup, retention, deletion eligibility, and quarantine share one referential-integrity boundary; recovery actions remain SWU-SFC-017.

units.primary_behavior: Simulate owner-approved patch, rollback, withdrawal, quarantine, and supersession transitions over local candidate fixtures while preserving history.
units.acceptance_boundary: Immutable versioned transitions pass while in-place repair, automatic rollback, missing approval, incompatible predecessor, and deletion mutants fail.
units.split_analysis: All recovery transitions share one state machine and history invariant; exact candidate freeze remains SWU-SFC-018.

units.primary_behavior: Freeze every acceptance-bound source, dependency, artifact, runtime, schema, profile, fixture, and receipt byte and prove declared mutations invalidate acceptance.
units.acceptance_boundary: The exact manifest has no drift and profile, meta-type, relation, runtime, dependency, source, schema, rule, evidence, and owner mutants all invalidate.
units.split_analysis: Corpus freeze and invalidation matrix are inseparable because a stable hash without semantic discriminators does not prove binding; operator usability remains SWU-SFC-019.

units.primary_behavior: Have one independent operator install the private candidate, run green and red cases, collect redacted diagnostics, recover, exercise guidance, and reach support.
units.acceptance_boundary: An identity-bound receipt covers exact candidate, commands, outputs, recovery, rollback or withdrawal guidance, and support; author substitution, leakage, undocumented steps, or missing red case fails.
units.split_analysis: Install, run, diagnose, recover, and support form one end-to-end operator journey; independent evidence audit remains SWU-SFC-020.

units.primary_behavior: Independently join the complete evidence set and issue only candidate-ready-for-owner-review or fail.
units.acceptance_boundary: All 20 source and closeout receipts plus decision, design, build, security, resource, compatibility, recovery, pilot, owner-separation, and claim-ceiling bindings resolve; stale or self-authored evidence fails.
units.split_analysis: Receipt coverage and owner or claim audit must join one exact candidate; actual release approval remains outside this unit and Work Pack.
